display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 弱信道扰动与等剂量五分支筛选
scope: F0 Main split original full reference-response PAMF, three SIG-TIME views and fixed permutation [0,5,3,6,2,1,4,7]. Three arms x seeds 2026092701/02/03. Target F0 has been exposed and is development evaluation.
initialization: Reuse exact source-only original same-seed Tri-SIG-TIME E20, continue own E10+E20 for fixed E50 and 11100 cumulative updates. Same original source L/U roles and model/head.

matrix.selection: all accepted U in original physical half
random accepted U count matching that step's actual branch certificate count
accepted U with at least four of five raw branches and four of five same-record simulated branches supporting pseudo class

method: Both random and branch routes evaluate the same detached five-branch certificate using raw and full-strength simulated IQ as a conservative channel stress test, with the same physical half, cross-RX current L anchors, source simulator, and independent deterministic random draws. Selected training slots get 0.75 raw plus 0.25 source-practical IQ; the remaining physical slots receive raw. The certificate checks the stronger simulated view rather than this interpolated input. Interpolation is a finite received-IQ proxy, not a separately sampled real propagation channel. Random dose matches the branch-eligible count within its own current batch; the learned trajectories differ, so matching is not claimed between models globally. Both baseline REPL loss and accepted raw pseudo labels, gradient guard, six U forwards, L supervision and default inference are retained. Original As simulator is fixed three-scene source-only, and U labels remain hidden.
controls: full-dose existing practical-U and gated-U results as historical comparators
evaluation: Fixed E50, clean and six practical scenarios, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L and raw secondary. Main test cross_rx plus cross_both, 168000 disjoint physical packets per scene. All nine frozen prediction matrices precede independent truth-last scores. Per seed, scene, TX/RX/day and same-packet correction/regression. No leo_weak.
success: Three-seed mean exceeds Tri on clean and practical-six mean, and exceeds PL in every scene. Disclose each seed loss; all-condition evidence additionally requires each PL seed/scenario cell positive and independent settings.
environment: N607 ordinary account and project Python, immutable release and unique run/output root, FP32/TF32 off.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --weak-practical --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: GPU 0–7, at most two observed or pending processes per GPU including other owners; one run owner and nine-row actual E20 no-query smoke.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch while healthy workers and outputs remain. No optional source diagnostics, target-driven tuning or rerun, or weak scoring.
expected_artifacts: Nine finite source-only real E20 smoke checks
Nine own E30/E50 and source U routing counts
